title: Phase I benign nevus ROI1 rep1.1 [NS1-A-1-1]
extract_protocol_ch1: Following standard ISH protocols, samples were incubated with 1) DNA oligo-barcoded ISH probes containing a UV-photocleavable linker and 2) flourescently labeled antibodies for visualization of morphological structures. Areas of interest (AOI) within the tissue were illuminated with UV light and oligo barcodes were physically aspirated from the tissue and collected into microtiter plates by the GeoMx® Digital Spatial Profiler (DSP) platform. For more information about DSP protocols please see Merritt et al. Nature Biotech 2020 (doi: 10.1038/s41598-020-63539-x)
extract_protocol_ch1.1: Each collection of oligo tags from one well (representing an AOI from the tissue section) was indexed with i7xi5 unique dual indexes using GeoMx SeqCode primers with 18 cycles of PCR.  After PCR, indexed AOIs were pooled and purified in two rounds of AMPure XP PCR purification using 1.2x bead:sample ratio. Concentration and purity of the resulting libraries was measured using a Bioanalyzer high-sensitivity DNA assay and Qubit high-sensitivity dsDNA kit.
data_processing.1: Adapter trimming with trim galore,  trimGaloreOpts = "" --hardtrim5 26 --dont_gzip""
data_processing.2: Merge overlapping R1 and R2 with flash2, flash2Opts = "" -m 26 -e 26 -f 26 -s 1 -r 27""
data_processing.4: Align RTS_IDs (probe barcodes) using bowtie2, bowtie2Opts = "" --end-to-end -L 4 --trim5 0 --trim3 0 --norc""
data_processing.6: Genome_build: N/A, sequencing of synthetic tags and alignment to whitelist of RTS_IDs (probe barcodes) found in the config.ini file
data_processing.7: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Digital Count Conversion (DCC) file format outputted from GeoMx NGS Pipeline, contains software versions, scan attributes, GeoMx NGS pipeline parameters and output metrics, Q30 scores, and list of deduplicated counts per RTS_ID (probe barcode)
data_processing.8: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Summarized count files generated by parsing DCC files and merging with sample annotations. Count values are the geometric mean of the probes for a given target, after removing any probes flagged as outliers.
data_processing.9: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: For Phase II (MK008), genes not detected in any AOIs were removed from the dataset, and the counts for each AOI were normalized to the upper quartile, yielding finalData file

Areas of interest (AOI) within the tissue were illuminated with UV light and oligo barcodes were physically aspirated from the tissue and collected into microtiter plates by the GeoMx® Digital Spatial Profiler (DSP) platform. For more information about DSP protocols please see Merritt et al. Nature Biotech 2020 (doi: 10.1038/s41598-020-63539-x)
extract_protocol_ch1.1: Each collection of oligo tags from one well (representing an AOI from the tissue section) was indexed with i7xi5 unique dual indexes using GeoMx SeqCode primers with 18 cycles of PCR.  After PCR, indexed AOIs were pooled and purified in two rounds of AMPure XP PCR purification using 1.2x bead:sample ratio. Concentration and purity of the resulting libraries was measured using a Bioanalyzer high-sensitivity DNA assay and Qubit high-sensitivity dsDNA kit.
data_processing.1: Adapter trimming with trim galore,  trimGaloreOpts = "" --hardtrim5 26 --dont_gzip""
data_processing.2: Merge overlapping R1 and R2 with flash2, flash2Opts = "" -m 26 -e 26 -f 26 -s 1 -r 27""
data_processing.4: Align RTS_IDs (probe barcodes) using bowtie2, bowtie2Opts = "" --end-to-end -L 4 --trim5 0 --trim3 0 --norc""
data_processing.6: Genome_build: N/A, sequencing of synthetic tags and alignment to whitelist of RTS_IDs (probe barcodes) found in the config.ini file
data_processing.7: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Digital Count Conversion (DCC) file format outputted from GeoMx NGS Pipeline, contains software versions, scan attributes, GeoMx NGS pipeline parameters and output metrics, Q30 scores, and list of deduplicated counts per RTS_ID (probe barcode)
data_processing.8: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Summarized count files generated by parsing DCC files and merging with sample annotations. Count values are the geometric mean of the probes for a given target, after removing any probes flagged as outliers.
data_processing.9: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: For Phase II (MK008), genes not detected in any AOIs were removed from the dataset, and the counts for each AOI were normalized to the upper quartile, yielding finalData file
